brief: Identify the different roles of public benefits, employer arrangements and personal savings.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Retirement Sources"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Fuentes distintas, condiciones distintas"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Fontes distintas, condições distintas"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Identify the different roles of public benefits, employer arrangements and personal savings.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Public benefits, employer arrangements and personal savings do not follow one shared set of rules.
instruction.misconception: Every retirement resource is the same kind of immediately owned and accessible money.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use only the visible fictional amounts and conditions; earlier arithmetic is preparation, not a hidden financial assumption.

evidence.reasoning: Public programs, employer plans and personal savings are distinct sources. Their eligibility, ownership and access rules must be checked separately.
The source is the public program with eligibility conditions.
The arrangement comes through the employer’s stated plan.
The savings are an existing resource owned by the person.
The sources have distinct conditions and timelines.
A plan cannot rely on a resource that does not exist.
Planning starts from real sources and verified conditions.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.
